summary: ArtifactRef v1 metadata points to owner-bound content-addressed objects; export identity is DB-unique and lease-fenced cluster-wide.
invariants: Artifact bytes are addressed by owner, tenant, and SHA-256 digest.
Export completion requires a fenced attempt and an owner-bound result ArtifactRef.
forbidden: Expose raw absolute artifact paths in worker or API contracts.
Use local filesystem as production artifact authority.
